## 3dslibris 3.1.1

This update fixes controls in landscape mode and makes a few everyday reading actions quicker. Bookmarks now work properly when reading sideways, you can hold the D-pad to move through links and images, and Settings pages flow into each other more naturally.

### Fixes and improvements

- [#178](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/178): in landscape mode, D-pad `UP` / `DOWN` jump between bookmarks again, the same as in portrait. Before, they also turned the page, so you never reached the bookmark. Holding `LEFT` / `RIGHT` still turns pages continuously.
- [#182](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/182): in link/image mode (hold `Y`), holding the D-pad keeps moving to the next or previous link or image, also across pages. This makes long tables of contents and indexes much faster to browse. It works whether or not you are still holding `Y`, and the Circle Pad follows the existing `circle pad page turn` setting.
- [#177](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/177): landscape mode now shows whether the current page has a bookmark. The page counter in the status bar shows `3/59*` on bookmarked pages and `3/59` on the rest, like the `< 3* >` marker in portrait.
- [#181](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/181): in Settings, moving back from the first option of a page now lands on the last option of the previous page, so the selection keeps its place instead of jumping to the top. Moving past the last option still opens the next page, with the D-pad or `L` / `R`.

### Updating

Reading progress, bookmarks, preferences and page caches are kept. Pages are not re-paginated.

### Downloads

- `3dslibris.cia` or `3dslibris.3dsx` for normal use.
- `3dslibris-sdmc.zip`: runtime files for Homebrew Launcher installs; use with the `.3dsx` download.
- Debug builds (`3dslibris-debug.cia` / `3dslibris-debug.3dsx`) and `3dslibris-source.tar.gz` are also included.

Thanks to everyone trying the builds and reporting issues. You can support the project with a ⭐ on GitHub or [a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/rigle).
